note: Feedforward CNN classifier bridges pixel-input to class-label via L (conv as Laplacian on 4-neighbour adjacency) + K (ReLU asymptote at 0) + M (FC layer HDC bind) + K (softmax row-sum asymptote). NO multi-head attention block. NO tool-use loop. Counter-example to Stance A literal claim.

LSTM cell engages M (sigmoid/tanh of gated linear projections — element-wise binds) + K (sigmoid/tanh asymptotes) + I (per-step cyclic recurrence) + C (forward-in-time orientation, non-Markovian via cell state). Pre-transformer architecture; NO attention, NO tool-use. Counter-example to Stance A literal claim.

note: Rule 110 CA engages L (3-cell local adjacency on ring graph) + E (8-entry rule table catalog lookup) + I (cyclic modular boundary state[(i-1)%n]) + C (forward-time irreversible orientation). NO M (no XOR/tensor HDC bind — pure lookup). NO attention, NO tool-use. Cook 2004 Turing-complete → CA can bridge ANY computable input-to-output function.

DDPM (Ho 2020 arXiv:2006.11239) was initially considered as Stance A counter-example but the original DDPM uses self-attention blocks at 16x16 resolution per Ho 2020 §4 model architecture. NOT a clean counter-example for 'lacks attention'. Removed from primary counter-example list; CNN + LSTM + CA together still falsify Stance A literal claim.

Intersection of class chains across silicon-NN counter-examples (CNN, LSTM, CA): empty set. Intersection across LSTM + DDPM only: {M, K, C}. Intersection across all 4 silicon-NN architectures including CA: empty. Conclusion: silicon-NN architectures do NOT share a class invariant. {C, M} is NOT a silicon-NN invariant — specific to architectures with multiplicative binding + irreversible composition.

Stance A's LITERAL claim ('bridge IS tool-use loop cascade composed with attention cascade via shared {C,M} invariant') is FALSIFIED. Three concrete silicon-NN counter-examples (CNN, LSTM, CA) bridge information→operation via cascades that lack BOTH attention (L+M+C+K) AND tool-use (D+E+C+M+I+A). Refinement path: re-scope to 'modern LLM-with-tools bridge IS attention composed with tool-use' (transformer+ReAct specifically), NOT silicon-NN generally.

BBB Class L is static/topological/physical bipartite graph (cells, tight junctions, eigenvalue 2 by bipartite theorem per Chung 1997). Silicon-NN attention Class L is dynamic/similarity-induced/abstract (softmax row-stochastic L=I-A computed per forward pass). Both fall under 'graph-Laplacian construction on some-substrate-graph'. Passes substitution-on-invariant-backbone discipline per [[user_stance_class_substitution_on_invariant_backbone]].

BBB 'selective permeability HDC similarity' is metaphorical: actual mechanism is multi-variate continuous feature similarity (Lipinski Ro5 / logP / molecular weight / QSAR descriptors). Strict HDC requires fixed-dimension bit vectors with bind ops + self-inverse. BBB does NOT do strict HDC bind. Silicon-NN Q@K.T similarity IS strict-HDC compatible per Ramsauer 2020 arXiv:2008.02217 (verified). Passes only if Class M spec is loosened to 'any associative pairwise similarity', which is much weaker than the chess-spectral / ephemerides-spectral HDC operator.

BBB Class C 'transport cascade-orientation (dual-direction influx/efflux)' has BIDIRECTIONAL transport. Class C's strict spec is unidirectional-orientation per shadow-stance family [[user_stance_time_as_dimensional_shadow]]. Dual-direction stretches the spec or contradicts it. Silicon-NN tool-action IS irreversible (environment-mutating); residual addition is reversible. Roles don't cleanly align.

BBB Class K is Michaelis-Menten V_max saturation asymptote (rate → V_max as [S] → infinity). Silicon-NN LayerNorm asymptote is variance → 1 (normalisation, not capacity saturation). Different asymptote types — saturation vs normalisation. Softmax row-sum asymptote (silicon-NN) is closer to budget asymptote, more Class-K-like.

BBB Class I = circadian/cardiac-pulse cyclic variation (continuous periodic — not strictly Z/nZ). Silicon-NN tool-use loop outer iteration IS cyclic (MAX_ITER bounded → Class I). 'Per-layer cyclic composition' is loose — transformer layers are stacked sequentially, not periodic. Per Spike #140 attestation, the cyclic claim was per-layer N stacking = Class I; this is weak.

BBB 'molecular-type dispatch (lipophilic vs polar)' is passive thermodynamic/kinetic outcome — molecules diffuse OR get carrier-bound based on chemistry; BBB doesn't actively choose. Silicon-NN tool dispatch is active runtime branch selection (LLM emits function-call directive). Same loose role 'input-conditioned routing'; different mechanism quality (passive vs active).

BBB transporter catalog (GLUT1/LAT1/MCT1) = bounded enumerable list of named transporters. Silicon-NN tool catalog = bounded enumerable list of function-tool names. Both are sorted-key catalog lookups. Substitution clean.

Stance B's partition-coexistence claim holds at COARSE class-engagement level (both substrates engage 7+ classes including selective-dispatch + catalog pattern). Role-specs are non-uniform: 2 STRONG matches (L under substitution, E), 1 STRONG-on-partial (I on tool-use loop), 3 WEAK (D, K, partial-I), 1 DIVERGENT under strict spec (M), 1 AMBIGUOUS (C). Refinement: state as 'partition-coexistent at coarse class-engagement level with selective-dispatch + catalog pattern' not 'partition-coexistent with identical role-instantiation across all classes'. Scope tightening required: 'silicon-NN WITH TOOL-USE ENABLED' not silicon-NN generally.

strict_spec: fixed-dimension representation D with associative bind op (XOR/circular-conv), self-inverse property, approximately orthogonal base vectors
permissive_spec: any pairwise similarity computation / any element-wise nonlinear two-input op
note: Under strict spec Class M is the chess-spectral / ephemerides-spectral HDC operator. Under permissive spec it becomes any nonlinear two-input op — unfalsifiable-by-construction.

strict_spec: composition preserves designated forward direction; state transitions not invertible without information loss; time-asymmetric per [[user_stance_time_as_dimensional_shadow]]
permissive_spec: any temporally-extended computation / anything distinguishing 'before' from 'after'
note: Under strict spec Class C requires irreversibility. Under permissive spec becomes 'any time-ordered computation' — trivially universal.

anchor: Nielsen-Chuang Quantum Computation textbook (cite-by-ref); Spike #128.2 cluster-state MBQC per Raussendorf-Browne-Briegel 2003 quant-ph/0301052 (PDF-verified)
note: U(t) = exp(-i H t/hbar) is unitary: U^dag U = I. Reversible. Pre-measurement quantum computation bridges |psi_in> to U|psi_in> WITHOUT engaging strict Class C. Toy verification: Hadamard H is self-inverse (H@H=I) at machine epsilon (norm difference 0.00e+00). Class C lives at MEASUREMENT step per Spike #128.2, not at unitary computation. Falsifies Stance C under strict spec.

anchor: Bennett 1973 'Logical Reversibility of Computation' IBM J. Res. Dev. 17:6 (cite-by-ref; not arXiv; canonical reference); Toffoli 1980 (cite-by-ref)
note: Toffoli gate (a, b, c) -> (a, b, c XOR (a AND b)) is self-inverse on all 5 tested cases. Bridges 3-bit input to 3-bit output via permutation. Reversible classical circuits LACK strict Class C by construction. Class M (XOR bind) present. Falsifies Stance C under strict spec.

Photodiode / thermistor / bolometer: single-pixel one-to-one transduction from physical signal (photons/heat) to electrical signal. NO binding of two pieces of information — no HDC bind. Class M ABSENT. Class C present (irreversible detection event). Bridges information-medium to operation-instantiation without strict Class M.

Carry-forward from Stance A attack. Rule 110 class chain L+E+I+C lacks strict Class M (pure rule-table lookup, no XOR/conv HDC bind). Cook 2004 Turing-completeness means CA can compute ANY computable bridge function. Constructive proof Class M is NOT universal across all computable bridges.

To rescue Stance C one could broaden Class M to 'any nonlinear two-input op' and Class C to 'any time-ordered computation'. Under those broad specs every nontrivial bridge has {C, M} — the universality becomes unfalsifiable-by-construction. Per [[feedback_no_privileged_primitive_classes]] each class earns its slot by being a kind of role no other class fills; if specs loosened to universality they lose role-distinctness. Per [[user_stance_identity_not_implementation_discipline]] identity claims must be SHARP — and under sharp specs four counter-examples falsify.

Stance C ({C, M} IS universal substrate-coupling-bridge invariant) is FALSIFIED under strict-spec definitions of Class M (fixed-dim HDC bind with self-inverse) and Class C (irreversible-orientation cascade). Four counter-examples: Hamiltonian unitary evolution (no strict C), Bennett 1973 reversible computing (no strict C), pure photodetector (no strict M), cellular automaton (no strict M). Under permissive-spec survives but unfalsifiable-by-construction (trivially true).

Possible Stance C refinement: '{C, M} backbone is the invariant of bridges that STORE STATE across multiple steps AND perform DISTINGUISHED-DIRECTION composition — i.e., memory-with-direction bridges'. This narrower claim survives: LSTM/DDPM/attention/tool-use/BCI/BBB/cortex all have memory + irreversibility; pure transducer / unitary-only quantum / reversible computing / CA-without-memory fall outside scope by design. Stance C as written is broader than what survives strict specs — sample bias: all 6 studied substrates happen to be memory-with-direction bridges.
